claims.citation: New York Herald, 4 May 1866, p. 8, col. 3
claims.verbatim:
REMARKABLE DISPATCH—Bark Daniel Webster, Nickerson,
sailed from Boston on the 4th of March for Messina, where
she arrived after a passage of 23 days; discharged her cargo,
reloaded and went to sea again for Boston April 4—just 31
days from Boston! It is believed that this was never before
equalled, the detention in port usually preventing the possi-
bility of it. In the present case the Daniel Webster slipped
in ahead of the fleet, and Capt Nickerson not only found his
agent in town, but no vessel on the berth waiting to load for
America.
